  1. jsimgraph.controller

Uses of Package
jsimgraph.controller

Packages that use jsimgraph.controller
Package
Description
common.panels
Panels of the JMT simulation model wizards: source, sink, queue, delay, fork, join, router, logger, class switch and related parameter panels used by JSIMgraph and JSIMwiz.
jsimgraph.JGraphMod
JGraph based graph editor of JSIMgraph: the cells, ports and views used to draw the queueing network topology in the graphical workspace.
jsimgraph.controller
Controllers of JSIMgraph: the mediator between the graph editor and the simulation model, and the simulation state checker.
jsimgraph.controller.actions
Actions of the JSIMgraph editor: menu and toolbar commands to create stations, connections and to run the simulations.
jsimgraph.definitions
Definition interfaces of the JSIMgraph model data source, shared between the graph editor and the model layer.
jsimgraph.mainGui
Main window of the JSIMgraph application.
jsimgraph.panels
Panels of the JSIMgraph application.
jsimgraph.template
Model templates of JSIMgraph, used to quickly create new simulation models.
